serviceHint: Push your live battles to your phone over the internet — on the phone open the Live page, connect once, and every battle of the account below arrives on its own.
rootHint: The official entry works out of the box; a custom entry points at your own deployment (deploy a private gateway from this computer's settings).
noAccount: No account is active yet — bind one under Settings → Accounts before starting the service.
captchaPendingHint: This node requires a one-time human verification — pass it in the card beside the game status (bottom-left) to start the push.
tipOnline: Gateway: pushing battles to your phone
captchaTitle: Pass the verification once to start the push
captchaHint: This node requires a one-time human verification (Cloudflare Turnstile). The push starts as soon as it passes.
waitingBattle: Waiting for the desktop to start a battle…
waitingHost: The desktop is offline — start WoWSP on your computer with the mobile service enabled.
battleEndedHint: Battle over — the roster stays until the next one starts.
passwordHint: This node requires a password. Ask its operator for it.
selfhostEnvHint: Checking the tools this wizard needs (node/npx, Rust + wasm32, worker-build). Missing pieces must be installed before continuing.
selfhostLoginHint: Log in to Cloudflare with wrangler (a browser window opens; the token stays in wrangler's own state and never enters this app).
selfhostRepoDirHint: Only needed when the app is not run from a checkout: the folder of your wowsp source clone the gateway worker deploys from. Leave empty to auto-detect (dev builds).
selfhostTargetHint: The subdomain to serve the gateway on, under a zone already in your Cloudflare account.
selfhostKvHint: The gateway keeps the last battle's snapshot in a KV namespace; the wizard creates or reuses GATEWAY_KV.
selfhostDeployHint: Generates wrangler.selfhost.toml and deploys the same worker build the official node runs.
selfhostVerifyHint: Verifies that your domain's /gateway/health endpoint answers a valid document.
selfhostPhoneHint: Enter this address on the phone: Settings → Gateway route → Custom.
selfhostLogEmpty: Nothing yet — run a step to see its output.
rootConnectExistingHint: Paste the gateway URL you deployed (or were given) and save to connect.
rootDeployHint: No gateway yet? Deploy your own private one in a few minutes.
